title: Privacy Policy
intro: In Ters, we are committed to protecting users’ privacy. We collect and use data only for purposes related to delivering our services in a safe and efficient manner.

items.text: Photos or videos of the vehicle condition or damage for inspection or technical reporting purposes.
Customer location is used to accurately direct technicians or tow trucks when providing services.
We use collected data for the following purposes:
Communicating with customers regarding order status.
Directing technicians and tow truck drivers accurately.
Issuing invoices and processing online payments.
Maintaining service records and continuously improving service quality.
We do not sell or share data with unrelated third parties. Data is only shared with parties required to deliver the service, including:
Payment service providers and related operational service providers.
Storing data in secure systems compliant with security standards.
Restricting access to authorized personnel only.
Ters may update this Privacy Policy at any time. Continued use of the application after updates indicates acceptance of the revised policy.
Using the application constitutes full acceptance of all terms of this Privacy Policy.
